where.claudeCode: Run this command in a terminal, at the root of your project. Then check it with claude mcp list.
where.cursor: Paste this into .cursor/mcp.json at the root of the project, or into ~/.cursor/mcp.json for all your projects, then enable the server in Cursor's MCP settings.
where.vscode: Paste this into .vscode/mcp.json at the root of the project, then start the server from the MCP: List Servers command.

secret: This configuration holds your token: do not commit it. Add the file to .gitignore, and revoke the token if it leaks.
